seoTitle: Instahyre Jobs Scraper - Experience, Skills & Dates
seoDescription: Scrape Instahyre jobs by skill, city and experience, newest first: posting date, experience range, skills, headcount and stipend. No login or API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured locally on 2026-11-08 (apify run, engine from the platform/instahyre branch): the example input took 85 s with a peak of 78 MB and 1.6 s of CPU; a search with details 176 s, 82 MB, 4.4 s CPU; 1,000 jobs 379 s, 104 MB, 13 s CPU. Runs wait on Instahyre's limits (20 searches a minute, about 1.5 job answers a second), not on CPU or memory, so more memory does not make them faster. minMemoryMbytes 256. Re-measure on Apify after the first push (time at 256, 512 and 1024 MB, the daily test input, platform usage).

Margin (SEO.md 16.4) from local runs of 2026-11-08 (wall time plus 5 s assumed for Apify's container start) at 512 MB (local:r2-01-example, local:r2-02-python-dev-bangalore, local:r2-06-python-bangalore-2-5, local:fix-03b-freshers, local:03-data-analyst-remote-7d, local:12-large-1000, local:04b-sales-ops-mumbai-details): cost $0.000014729 a job and $0.00004232 a job with details plus $0.0015365 a run on FREE unit prices; lowest margin of a run 66% (the smallest run). apply false until the margins are measured on Apify: once a first set is live, CI applies decreases only (store-metadata.mjs). isPublic stays false until the owner's check.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing: 5-15% under the main Instahyre actor, Store discounts

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, city, experience range, skills, job category, posting date, link, and the company's headcount and founding year. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, and the company's industry, website, LinkedIn, tech stack, benefits and Glassdoor ratings when Instahyre shows them.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.001 at the default 512 MB. It pays for finding Instahyre's newest job, which every run that reads the newest jobs does first.
